messages.content: Summarize DH-8406-223, Hana Lindqvist. Aug 1 insurance changed (new employer). Aug 2 old plan's PA for knee surgery consult no longer valid. Aug 3 new insurance added in MyVisit. Aug 4 PA resubmitted to new plan. Aug 8 approved.

Hana Lindqvist changed insurance on Aug 1 with a new employer, which meant the prior authorization from her old plan for a knee surgery consult was no longer valid. She added her new insurance in MyVisit on Aug 3, our PA team resubmitted on Aug 4, and the new plan approved it on Aug 8. The consult should no longer show "Pending PA" in ClinicBoard. Next step: call Hana to book the consult.
When do LabLink results get released?

Most results release within 3 business days. Pathology and imaging can take up to 7 business days because the provider reviews them first. We never interpret results; send patients to their provider (MyVisit message, reply within 2 business days), a care-team call-back, or the Nurse Line at 555-0160.
Walk me through the billing dispute timeline.

We acknowledge a dispute within 2 business days and resolve it within 10 business days. As soon as it's opened, the account goes on a 30-day billing hold, so no late notices go out. Disputes over $500 go to Declan Whitcombe, the Billing Supervisor.
Why can't I book online anymore? MyVisit says online booking is unavailable for my account.

Thanks for asking, and I'm sorry for the surprise. Under our no-show policy, if there are 3 missed appointments within 12 months, online booking in MyVisit is paused for 6 months. You can still book any visit by calling the Patient Support Line at 555-0142, and we'll find you a time. If you believe one of those missed visits was recorded by mistake, we'd be glad to call you and look into it.
pls stop texting me appointment reminders 3 times a day, it's too much

Sorry about the extra texts! You can change your reminder settings in MyVisit under Profile > Notifications, where you can pick email only, text only, or fewer reminders. We can also update it for you after a quick identity check. Would you like us to give you a call and set it up?
The virtual visit link isn't loading and my appointment is in 5 minutes!!

I'm sorry, let's get you connected. Please try opening the link from the MyVisit app under Visits, and make sure your browser or app has permission to use your camera and microphone. If it still won't load, reply here or call us at 555-0142 and we'll let your provider know you're trying to join. We can also call you right away to help.
how much does a virtual visit cost without insurance

Thanks for asking. A self-pay Virtual Visit is $45. If you pay the balance in full within 30 days of your first statement, you'll also get a 10% prompt-pay discount. Virtual visits are booked in MyVisit and last about 15 minutes. Would you like us to call you to book one?
I got a paper bill but I don't have a MyVisit login. Can I just pay it online without signing up?

Yes, you can. Dunmore Pay has a Guest Pay option. You'll just need the account number from your paper statement and the patient's last name. If you'd like to set up a payment plan or see past statements later, creating a MyVisit account makes that easier. We can also take the payment over the phone if you'd like a call.
I got a no-show fee but I was in the ER that day!! I have the discharge papers.

I'm sorry you were in the ER, and I hope you're recovering well. Missed visits because of an emergency or hospital stay can be waived. Our Patient Support Lead, Marisol Okafor, reviews these, and she'll be in touch within 1 business day. You can upload your discharge papers in MyVisit under Documents to help speed things up. We can also call you to talk it through.
